(I)--an attendant in वैकुण्ठ cursed by Sanaka and others to be born as an Asura. The curse was confirmed by Hari, who, however, consoled him and Vijaya (s.v.). His fall.
1: भा. III. १६. 2, २६-37.
In the देवासुर war with Bali, he attacked Bali's fol- lowers.
2: Ib. VIII. २१. १६.
(II)--a son of Vatsara and स्वर्वीथि. भा. IV. १३. १२.
(III)--a sage of the epoch of the tenth Manu. भा. VIII. १३. २२; २१. १६.
(IV)--a son of श्रुत (सुश्रुत-ब्र्। प्। and वा। प्।), and father of Vijaya. भा. IX. १३. २५; Br. III. ६४. २२; वा. ८९. २१; Vi.
(V)--a son of पुरूरवस् and ऊर्वशी, and father of Amita. भा. IX. १
(VII)--a son of सञ्जय and father of Krta. भा. IX. १७. १६-17; वा. ९३. 8. Vi.
(VIII)--a son of सङ्कृति and a great warrior. With him came to an end the क्षत्रवृद्ध line. (Burnouf makes क्षत्रधर्मन् his son. The term is only an epithet of Jaya). भा. IX. १७. १८.
(X)--a son of युयुधान and father of कुणि. भा. IX. २४. १४.
(XI)--a son of Kanka and कर्णिका. भा. IX. २४. ४४.
(XIV)--a नाग of the fifth or महातलम्. Br. II. २०. ३७; वा. ५०. ३६.
(XVII)--a son of Kali and grandson of वरुण. Br. III. ५९. 7; वा. ८४. 7.
(XVIII)--a son of Vijaya; father of हर्यश्वक. Br. III. ६८. 9; वा. ९३. 9.
(XIX)--a son of सृञ्जय, and father of Vijaya. Br. III. ६८. 8.
(I)--the son of Ahina, father of सङ्कृति. Br. III. ६८. १०.

(II)--a son of सार्वभौम
1: M. ५०. ३६; वा. ९९. २३१.
and father of आराधित.
2: Vi. IV. २०. 4.
[page१-634+ २९]
(III)--a son of अदीन and father of सङ्कृति. वा. ९३. १०; Vi.

--are twelve in number created by ब्रह्मा, bodies of मन्त्र used in यज्ञस्; these are दर्श, पौर्ण- मास, बृहद्य, रथन्तरम्, वित्ति, विवित्ति, आकूति, कूति, विज्ञासा, विज्ञात, मनस् and यज्ञ। These were again born as Jitas in the Svayambhuva epoch. ब्रह्मा asked them to observe household duties and यज्ञस्, but they took to ज्ञान। The enraged creator cursed them to undergo seven वृत्तिस्। They were born in turn as Ajitas, तुषितस्, Satyas, Haraya, वैकुण्थस्, साद्यस्, and आदित्यस्. Br.
(I)--the son of बृहद्काय and father of विशद. भा. IX. २१. २२-23.
(II)--the son of बृहन्मनस् and father of Vijaya. His wife was सम्भूति. भा. IX. २३. ११-12; वा. ९९. १११; Vi. IV. १८. २२-23.

(III)--the king of Sindhu and an ally of जरासन्ध; was stationed at the north gate of मथुरा, and on the east during the siege of Gomanta; served Duryo- dhana's army. भा. X. ५२. ११[6]; ५०. ११[7]; ७८. [९५ (v) १६]; Vi. V. ३८. १६.
(IV)--a son of the second सावर्ण Manu. Br.
(VII)--a son of बृहद्कर्मन् and father of विश्वजित्. Vi. IV. १९. ३४.
(I)--a son of Marutvati and Dharma; an अम्श of वासुदेव, otherwise known as Upendra. भा.
(II)--a son of Indra and शची; attacked Asura followers of Bali. Identified with Hari. भा. VI. १८. 7; VIII. २१. १७;
(IV)--the city founded by Nimi near the आश्रम of Gautama. Br. III. ६
(VI)--a consort of कीर्ति and who left him for Soma (s.v.). M. २३. २५. [page१-636+ २८]
(VII)--a son of वृषभ and जयन्ती; father of अक्रूर. M. ४५. २६; भा. I. १४. २८.
(VIII)--a विनायक, to be worshipped in house- building. M. १८३. ६३; २५३. २३ and ४०; २५५. 8; २६६. ४३.
(IX)--Mt. a कुलपर्वत of the केतुमाल. वा. ४४. 4.
(I)--Bestowed by Indra in marriage to ऋषभ. Mother of a hundred sons among whom was Bharata. भा.
(II)--the night on which कृष्ण was born. Br. III. ७१. २०५; वा. ९६. २०१.
(III)--daughter of Indra, sent by her father for the service of शुक्र during his धूम्रव्रत for

years; rendered him services; pleased with her शुक्र lived with her for ten years, as her husband;
1: Br. III. ७२. १५०, १५६; ७३. 3; वा. ९७. १४९; ९८. 3.
the result of this was the birth of देवयानी.
2: M. ४७. ११४-88; Br.
(V)--the wife of वृषभराग and daughter of काशी. M. ४५. २६.
(IV)--a goddess enshrined at हस्तिनापुर; a mother-goddess. M. १३. २८; १७९. १३; वा. 1. १५३. [page१-637+ २५]

--made by विशुक्र to out- wit the hosts of ललिता; its effect was the stupefication of all the शक्तिस् and making them speak irrelevantly of the leaders and minister for war; destroyed by गणनाथ Gaja1nana. Br. IV. २७. २४ and ५४.
(I)--a son of Hina (अहीन B), and father of सङ्कृति. भा. IX. १७. १७-18.
(II)--the son of सार्वभौम and father of राधिक. भा. IX. २२. १०.
(III)--married राजधिदेवी who became the mother of two sons, आवन्त्यस्. भा. IX. २४. ३९.
--an यक्ष; a son of देवयानी. Br.
--a lake in the Kuru country; sacred to पितृस्. M. २२. ४९; १२१. ७०.
